subject: Southampton extend Tonda Eckert's contract to 2029 despite the Spygate scandal
title: A contract to 2029, football's pension plan

lines.vo: Thrown out of a final, then given a deal to twenty twenty-nine.
On the twentieth of November, Southampton gave head coach Tonda Eckert a new contract running to twenty twenty-nine.
In May, Southampton were removed from the Championship play-off final.
This season they also lost four points, after admitting breaches of EFL rules.
Owner Dragan Solak has backed Eckert throughout. Loyalty, with a signature on it.
Middlesbrough lost that final one-nil to Hull City at Wembley on the twenty-third of May. One goal, one very long afternoon.
lines.footage: Hull City beat Middlesbrough play-off final goal, Wembley

lines.vo: Twenty twenty-nine. In football, that is practically a pension plan.

inserts.story: Setup: a paper cut-out Eckert signs a contract on a tiny cardboard desk. Gag: the page keeps unrolling past the desk, down the steps and out of the stadium gate. Twist: a cut-out postman walks along it with a flag, still reading, and gets to 2029 at sunset.
inserts.characters: Generic cut-out postman; caricature of Tonda Eckert

inserts.story: Setup: a cut-out owner in a woolly jumper hugs a cut-out Eckert. Gag: the hug lasts so long that a cut-out clock spins and a cobweb grows between them. Twist: a cut-out cleaner sweeps the cobweb away and the hug is still going.
inserts.characters: Generic cut-out owner and cleaner; caricature of Tonda Eckert

inserts.story: Setup: a cut-out Eckert opens a tiny paper retirement-party banner. Gag: it says 'Pension plan' and a cut-out accountant hands him a calculator. Twist: the calculator shows 2029 and it plays a happy jingle.
inserts.characters: Generic cut-out accountant; caricature of Tonda Eckert
